stories.title: STF limita punição a empresas em débito com União por distribuição de bonificações a acionistas

en.title: Supreme Court limits punishment of companies in debt with Union over shareholder bonus distributions
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court has restricted penalties imposed on companies that owe money to the federal government when they distribute bonuses to shareholders.

en.title: What is Paula Belmonte's (PSDB) ballot number for the Federal District government?
en.summary: Paula Belmonte from PSDB is running for Federal District governor in Brazil's 2026 elections and has ballot number 45.

stories.title: Assista aos telejornais da TV Liberal

en.title: Watch TV Liberal's news programs
en.summary: G1 broadcasts TV Liberal's first and second edition news programs.

stories.title: Lula, Caiado e Augusto Cury assinam carta contra trabalho escravo

en.title: Lula, Caiado and Augusto Cury sign letter against slave labor
en.summary: Presidential candidates Lula, Caiado, and Augusto Cury are among politicians who signed a commitment to combat slavery-like labor practices if elected.

stories.title: Receita Federal apreende 366 kg de cocaína em carga de café no Porto de Santos

en.title: Federal Revenue Service seizes 366 kg of cocaine in coffee shipment at Santos Port
en.summary: Brazilian authorities seized 366 kilograms of cocaine hidden in coffee bags at Santos Port in São Paulo. The drug was concealed in a 77-ton coffee shipment destined for Barcelona, Spain, and discovered during routine customs inspection.

stories.title: ONG que acolhe mulheres vítimas de violência encerra serviço após Prefeitura não renovar parceria em Mogi das Cruzes

en.title: NGO providing shelter for women victims of violence ends service after municipality fails to renew partnership in Mogi das Cruzes
en.summary: An NGO providing shelter for women experiencing domestic violence will cease operations in Mogi das Cruzes at the end of 2026. The municipality decided not to extend its partnership agreement with the organization beyond that date.

stories.title: Qual é o número de Rosilene Santana (UP) para o Senado na Paraíba?

en.summary: Rosilene Santana is running for Senate in Paraíba on the UP ticket with ballot number 800 in the October 4, 2026 Brazilian election.

en.title: What is Kiko Caputo's (Novo) ballot number for Governor of the Federal District?
en.summary: Kiko Caputo is a Novo candidate for Governor of the Federal District with ballot number 30 in the October 4, 2026 Brazilian election.

stories.title: PF indicia fundador da Reag e mais 12 por gestão fraudulenta e lavagem no setor de combustíveis

en.title: PF indicts founder of Reag and 12 others for fraudulent management and money laundering in fuel sector
en.summary: Federal Police indicted the founder of Reag and twelve other individuals on charges related to fraudulent management and money laundering activities within the fuel industry.

stories.title: Homem armado com faca faz atendente de farmácia refém na zona sul de SP

en.title: Armed man with knife takes pharmacy attendant hostage in southern São Paulo
en.summary: Military police negotiated for approximately two hours to secure the release of a hostage held at knifepoint by a man inside a pharmacy in southern São Paulo on Wednesday afternoon.

stories.title: PF indicia ex-dono da Reag por suspeita de lavagem de dinheiro de Beto Louco

en.title: PF indicts former Reag owner on suspicion of money laundering by Beto Louco
en.summary: Federal Police indicted businessman João Carlos Mansur, former owner of Reag, for suspected money laundering and criminal organization involvement related to tax irregularities in the fuel sector connected to Roberto Augusto Leme da Silva.

en.summary: An armed man took a pharmacy attendant hostage in southern São Paulo.

stories.title: Trump diz que Powell deveria ser forçado a deixar o Fed

en.title: Trump says Powell should be forced to leave the Fed
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell should be forced to resign from his position on the central bank's monetary policy committee, citing cost overruns on a building project at the Fed's Washington headquarters.

stories.title: Credores da Tahto, controlada da Oi, aprovam plano de recuperação judicial

en.title: Tahto creditors approve judicial recovery plan
en.summary: Creditors of Tahto, a subsidiary of Oi, approved the company's judicial recovery plan in an assembly. The plan will now be submitted for approval by a Rio de Janeiro court to ensure Tahto's operational viability and financial sustainability.

stories.title: Leonardo Avalanche desiste de candidatura à Presidência pelo PRTB

en.title: Leonardo Avalanche withdraws candidacy for Presidency from PRTB
en.summary: Leonardo Alves de Araújo, national president of PRTB, withdrew his candidacy for Brazil's presidency, citing technical, legal, and personal reasons just days before the first round of voting.

stories.title: Mensagens mostram que Vorcaro fez evento com 99 mulheres após fórum em Londres com autoridades

en.title: Messages show Vorcaro held event with 99 women after London forum with authorities
en.summary: Federal Police extracted messages from ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone revealing he organized an after-party with 99 women in London in April 2024, following a banking forum that included high-ranking Brazilian government officials and prosecutors.

stories.title: Podcast: a nova disputa por atenção no digital

en.title: Podcast: the new battle for digital attention
en.summary: Changing content consumption patterns are expanding the role of podcasts in Brazil's media market, with production, distribution, and discovery becoming central challenges. Podcasts have evolved beyond traditional audio-only experiences.
